collection.description: Families gather to remember loved ones beneath fruit trees.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Families gather to remember loved ones beneath fruit trees.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Laughter and tears mingle in affectionate memories.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One family chooses silence and is respected.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The grove gains young trees for future generations.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The families decide to care for existing trees instead.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Adults offer gentle explanations of remembrance.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) asks something nobody knows how to answer.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Families remember in their own ways.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Several families plan a shared remembrance next season.
